en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional German half‑timbered building with a steep tiled roof. A sign on the facade reads "Altdeutsche Bier- u. Weinstuben, Vincenz Richter". Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand at the entrance at the top of a staircase. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as Meissen and describes the establishment as Vincenz Richter's old German beer and wine tavern near the town church.
